design.notes: Matrix (booklet) item sampling. TIMSS 2023 data collection was in calendar 2023 for both hemispheres (northern typically March-June; southern typically August-November; IEA TIMSS 2023 International Results). One sidecar per cycle; participating countries are store sub-jurisdictions from IDCNTRY. This administration is the TIMSS-L 2024 linked base (see timss-l-intl-2024).

enrollment.note: SCIENCE is part of the TIMSS 2023 cycle but is out of first-pass cutscore scope (MATHEMATICS only). The same four International Benchmark points apply; they are not authored on this record.

MATHEMATICS.notes: IEA names four International Benchmarks (Low / Intermediate / High / Advanced); the floor below 400 is not an IEA label and is recorded here as Below Low so cut count = n_labels - 1. proficient_from is a placeholder choice for SGPc's margins layer, not an IEA designation.

cutscores_provenance: MATHEMATICS only (maintainer first-pass). Grade 4 and grade 8 share the TIMSS International Benchmarks: Low 400, Intermediate 475, High 550, Advanced 625. TIMSS 2023 Technical Report Ch. 14: cut points originally selected in TIMSS 2003 and constant across cycles (Gonzalez et al., 2004); descriptions updated each cycle. Same vectors as timss-intl-2019. Human promotes to reviewed (A3.4 gate).
